reconcile.note: Clarke argues the Hebrew phrase for all the face of the earth in the famine account designates Egypt alone, not the whole globe.

sides.snippet: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
sides.verseText: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.\"

sides.snippet: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold to the Egyptians.
sides.verseText: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
